what_was_checked: Neutral-site treatment of the Week 11 slate against the official 2026 International Games slate

population: 1 international game in Week 11 (MIN at SF, Estadio Banorte, Mexico City)
result: Agreement: the by-week page labels MIN at SF as the Mexico City game and the operations page lists it as Nov. 22 (Week 11), Estadio Banorte. The neutral_site flag is set only on this row (Flag F57)

what_was_checked: C09 calibration interval recomputed from the published model output
how_it_was_checked: slope and its standard error were recomputed independently from data/model_backtest.csv (n = 89, df = 87), then the t interval and the p-value against a slope of 1.0 were computed and compared with data/correlations_computed.csv
result: slope 0.8868, SE 0.2803, t(0.975, 87) 1.98761 -> CI 0.3297-1.4439, t = -0.404, p = 0.6874. Register now publishes 0.328-1.443 and p 0.6830. The previously published 0.830-0.923 and p 0.0000 were a correlation interval applied to a slope (Flag F58)
